text:
Morgan: FYI vendor quota dashboard shows A100 pool in us-west2 down to 7 available units, forecasted replenishment in ~36h. We have two canary runs tonight that assume 8 GPUs. Can we confirm fallback plan?
Jules: moving the canaries to eu-west1 is simplest. eu-west1 has spare H100/A100. Latency should be fine for canary metrics, but we should validate.
Pat: @Jules +1. Need to check tenant affinity and billing tags first — want to avoid cross-region cost surprises. Which tenant is this for?
Morgan: Tenant = demo-tenant (proj: demo-slate). Alternative is reducing per-instance batch size to 4 to fit current us-west2 capacity.
Sam: I'm on-call tonight and can trigger fallback if we decide. Quick steps: create a tiny infra PR switching zone. Example:
```
git checkout -b eu-canary-fallback
sed -i 's/zone: us-west2/zone: eu-west1/' infra/overlays/canary.yaml
git commit -am "canary: point to eu-west1 for tonight"
git push origin eu-canary-fallback
```
Nina: please tag the PR with `infra:canary-fallback` and include `cost-center: e2e-demo` in the description. Also add a short rollback note.
Priya: I'll open the PR and assign @Sam for apply. ETA ~20m.
Jules: small note — moving region will cold-start KV cache. Add a warmup job so the first telemetry window isn't noisy. Suggest: `kubectl run warmup --image=redwood/warmup:latest --restart=Never --env=MODEL=redwood-7B`
Sam: will run warmup after apply. @infra-bot can you reserve a temporary burst slot if vendor confirms shortfall?
infra-bot: scheduled temporary burst reservation: +2 A100 for demo-tenant in us-west2 (hold 6h). Fallback plan recorded under `ops/fallbacks/demo-slate`. :white_check_mark: 
Morgan: thanks — one more ask: if vendor signals a 48h replenishment window we should proactively notify sales about the demo timing. @Priya can you draft a short note for sales?
Priya: yup. Draft DM to sales-cr: "Heads up — small capacity issue in us-west2 this evening may affect demo timing; we have a failover to eu-west1 in place and expect no customer-visible impact." I'll DM and cc @Morgan.
Sam: PR merged and apply queued. I'll post when apply completes.
infra-bot: apply succeeded: canary overlay now pointing at eu-west1. Warmup job started.
Jules: seeing ~2-3s higher p50 for the first 100 requests in the meter — expected while KV warms. We'll monitor for the next 30m.
Morgan: closing loop — thanks folks. :rocket:
